verdict.rationale: The DOS's own incorporation pages publish exact dollar amounts: the $125 statutory filing fee for a Certificate of Incorporation, a $5 per-name search fee, and expedite surcharges of $25 (24h), $75 (same day) and $150 (2h). The founder does not need a contact form to learn the core costs. The online-rail fee is printed with an apparent typo ("The filling fee is $9"), which makes its exact amount ambiguous. Missing for 10: an unambiguous online filing fee, published amounts for the add-on services (plain/certified copies, certificate of existence) and for name reservation in the evidence, and independent corroboration.
